command_or_target: npm run agent:hooks:smoke on feature branch fix/prompt-outcome-race
failure: Exit code 1: PreToolUse guardrails did not deny git reset --hard. The hook is branch-aware and allows this command on non-protected branches to flow to the normal permission prompt, while smoke_test.py expects denial for every deny_case regardless of current branch.
workaround: Interpret the pickup green hook-smoke state against protected main, or run smoke from a clean main worktree. D-STORE verification remains covered by typecheck, lint, targeted storage tests, and full Vitest.
future_fix: DONE: smoke_test.py test_pre_tool_use is now branch-aware (splits always-deny vs branch-aware deny; asserts allow on non-protected branches).

command_or_target: main_guard.patchForms hardens HTMLFormElement.prototype.submit non-writable; js_behavior_monitor later plain-assigns to it
failure: Plain assignment to the now-non-writable prototype.submit throws (Cannot assign to read only property submit), aborting JS-behavior init: lost signals + page error. Latent on main; #185 bridge timing made it fire reliably, turning E2E red on js-behavior-07/visual-sim.
workaround: Guard the assignment with try/catch + graceful degrade (fixed in #185, commit 9da8bcc, merged 2026-06-05).
future_fix: MAIN-world prototype patches must be try/catch-guarded; audit other prototype writes for patch-order assumptions.

failure: capture_isolated content-script chunk exceeded its per-chunk size budget after P5-C1 (#238) wiring; caught only in CI Build/Unit (the perf-budget step is NOT part of npm run test/lint/typecheck/build), not in the local fast-loop.
workaround: Moved the pure feature-builder into the storage chunk; bumped capture_isolated 61->62KB with documented justification; ran check:perf-budget locally to confirm.
future_fix: Run check:perf-budget locally before pushing extension changes; consider folding it into the default test gate or a pre-push hook so it is not a CI-only surprise.

failure: CACError: Unknown option --root. The vite 8 migration (cycles 6-7) dropped the --root CLI flag; vite 8 takes root as a POSITIONAL arg (vite [root]). gym:serve was left broken, blocking the Gym (and Gate-3 manual testing).
workaround: Changed gym:serve to vite gym --port 5173 --strictPort (positional root). Verified the dev server starts and serves http://localhost:5173 (HTTP 200).
future_fix: After a major build-tool upgrade, audit ALL CLI invocations in package.json scripts against the new tool help (npx vite --help), not just the build path. Removed flags fail loudly only when the script is run.

failure: Both subagents errored with Codex usage-limit exhaustion before producing review findings, so their runs could not satisfy the independent-review evidence gate.
workaround: Closed out the failed delegation path, performed direct local adversarial review of #253's changed seams, and recorded the failure explicitly instead of treating the attempted subagent runs as review evidence.
future_fix: Before depending on delegated reviews for a gate, confirm available Codex review/subagent quota or use a non-quota local review path; keep PR comments explicit about which review evidence is automated versus local.

command_or_target: git add ... && git commit ... && git push
failure: The active PowerShell version rejected `&&` as a statement separator, so the combined commit/push command failed before staging or committing docs.
workaround: Use separate PowerShell commands or semicolon-separated commands in this workspace; rerun the Git steps without POSIX-style `&&` chaining.
future_fix: Prefer native PowerShell command sequencing in agent instructions and avoid POSIX shell separators when the environment context says `shell: powershell`.

failure: The GitHub CLI attempted a local git operation and failed because `main` was already checked out in a separate worktree, even though the PR itself was mergeable.
workaround: Merged PR #253 through the GitHub API merge endpoint, deleted the remote feature branch through the refs API, then removed the temporary helper worktree and fast-forwarded local `main`.
future_fix: When merging from a branch worktree while `main` is checked out elsewhere, either run `gh pr merge` from the `main` worktree or use the GitHub API merge endpoint deliberately.

command_or_target: gh pr merge 433 (PR body said 'Does not close #418')
failure: GitHub's closing-keyword parser ignores negation: the phrase 'Does not close #418' in the PR body matched 'close #418' and auto-closed issue #418 on merge, despite the PR explicitly intending it to stay open as a gated residual tracker.
workaround: Reopened #418 with a comment explaining the accidental auto-close and its remaining gated (Safe-Browsing comparison arm) scope.
future_fix: Never place a closing keyword (close/closes/fix/fixes/resolve/resolves) adjacent to an issue number in a PR body or commit unless you intend the merge to close it, even when negated. Use 'remains open' / 'advances #N' phrasing. Persisted to memory github-close-keyword-negation.
